fx_rates_usd_base.note: Pinned for consistency across all collection agents. Snapshot early 2026; Gulf currencies are USD-pegged (exact). Comparisons robust to small FX drift.

confidence_tiers.official: Government/statistical body (gov sites, BLS, OECD, WMO)
confidence_tiers.index: Established published index (WHR, GPI, EF EPI, HDI)
confidence_tiers.crowd: Crowd-sourced or survey (Numbeo, levels.fyi, InterNations, Glassdoor)

salary_usd_year.desc: Gross annual dev salary, 3 bands: new_grad / mid (3-5y) / senior (6y+)

col_single_no_rent_usd_month.desc: Monthly living costs, single person, excluding rent

apt_price_center_usd_m2.desc: Apartment purchase price per m2, centre

apt_price_outside_usd_m2.desc: Apartment purchase price per m2, outside centre

climate.primary: WMO climate normals / climate-data.org / Wikipedia climate boxes

tehran_travel.desc: Typical door-to-door flight hours + number of stops from Tehran IKA

visa_skilled_routes.desc: Main skilled visa routes, requirements, thresholds, realistic difficulty

study_pathway.desc: International master's tuition/yr + post-study work visa months

iran_friction.desc: Extra processing time / rejection risk for Iranian passport holders: low|medium|high + notes

pr_years_typical.desc: Typical years from arrival to permanent residency

citizenship_years_typical.desc: Typical years from arrival to citizenship eligibility

dual_citizenship.desc: Dual citizenship permitted (relevant: Iran does not release citizens easily)

tax_net_pct.desc: Net take-home % for single person at mid-level dev salary, incl. expat schemes

indices.desc: WHR score/rank, GPI rank, HDI, EF EPI, Numbeo QoL, healthcare index

language.desc: official language, work_english high|medium|low, language required for PR/citizenship

reality_paragraph.desc: Short honest narrative per country incl. Iranian community perspective

computed_metrics.feasibility_score: Group A weighted vs user profile (experience, study willingness, passport)
computed_metrics.attractiveness_score: Groups B-F weighted by user preset/sliders
computed_metrics.climate_match_pct: distance between city climate vector and user preference profile
